# fortiappseccloud_waf_template_parameter_validation

Configures parameter validation for one FortiAppSec Cloud WAF template using the static template endpoint `/waf/template/{template_id}/parameter_validation`. This resource owns the template's module settings. To make an application inherit them, configure the matching app module resource with `template = true` and omit its `configs` block.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_parameter_validation` resource for a WAF template.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_template_parameter_validation" "example" {
  template_id = fortiappseccloud_waf_template.example.template_id

  configs {
    status = true

    rule_list {
      item {
        name         = "param-rule"
        url          = "/api/params"
        action       = "alert_deny"
        block_period = 60

        sub_rule_list {
          item {
            name       = "username"
            arg_type   = "data-type"
            arg_val    = "string"
            max_len    = 128
            required   = true
            type_check = true
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Configuration Notes

- Rules using a data-type check must include a compatible `arg_val`; set it explicitly as shown instead of relying on an API default.

## Argument Reference

- `template_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — WAF template ID.
- `configs` (Required) — Typed parameter validation configuration. Its attributes and ownership-wrapper blocks are identical to `fortiappseccloud_waf_parameter_validation` when that app resource uses `template = false`.

## Import

Import using the template ID:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_template_parameter_validation.example TEMPLATE_ID
```

The first read after import hydrates all supported ownership wrappers.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
